samples.labelBasis: Human-confirmed equipped move and bounded attacker context; not an automatic acoustic identity.
samples.notes: Exact unchanged retained PCM window. Begins within an existing effect and decays to silence. Recognition excerpt only; not a complete replay effect.

confirmation.note: The user confirmed only Mawile attacked in the original controlled battle and identified its equipped move as Fire Fang. This constraint is scoped to that original battle; it does not apply throughout the separate repeat recording. No music-slider setting is asserted here.

samples.processing: Unmodified complete retained WAV bytes, including original rate, channels, amplitude and header. No resampling, filtering, normalization, subtraction, stitching, synthesis or looping.
